subject: Hall Boys — AI Discovery Questionnaire (v2, branded)
body:
Sarat,

Updated draft of the Hall Boys AI Discovery questionnaire is attached. Two changes from v1:

1) Plumbing section reframed as project management. Section 2B is now "Plumbing Project Management (New Construction)." Q13/Q16/Q18 reframed from foreman-level field execution to PM-level visibility, scope handoff, and multi-trade coordination. Q1 and Q5 swapped foreman language for PM/super loading.

2) Novendor branding applied — header banner, brand colors, Cambria headings, Calibri body. Same content underneath, just dressed up.

Take a pass when you can. Flag anything you want cut or sharpened before we send to Hallboys. The original v1 docx in Drive is untouched if you want to diff.

— Paul
